mnemonic.meaning: 我 self + 慢 lazy: your lazy self wants to quit, but you grit your teeth and put up with it.
mnemonic.reading: "Gah, man!" you groan (が・まん), but you keep enduring.

examples.ja: 痛かったけど、最後まで我慢した。
examples.en: It hurt, but I put up with it until the end.

items.note: 我慢する means to endure or hold back. Don't mix it up with 自慢 (じまん), bragging.

mnemonic.meaning: 節 moderation + 約 cut down: you moderate and cut down your spending. That's economizing.
mnemonic.reading: せつ as in 季節 (season), やく as in 約束 (promise): you promise yourself to save every season.

examples.ja: 電気代を節約するために、エアコンを消した。
examples.en: I turned off the air conditioner to save on electricity.

items.note: 節約 = use less. 貯金 = put money aside.

mnemonic.meaning: 冷 cold: you make something colder. You let it cool.
mnemonic.reading: Uncle SAM'S SOUP (さます) is scalding, so he lets it cool. (冷める さめる = it cools by itself.)

examples.ja: 熱いお茶を冷ますために、しばらく置いておく。
examples.en: I leave the hot tea for a while to let it cool.

items.note: 冷ます and 覚ます (wake someone up) are both さます. The other reading of 冷, ひ, is used in 冷やす.

mnemonic.meaning: 手 hand + 術 technique: a skilled hand technique. Surgery.
mnemonic.reading: The surgeon's secret ninja move: SHU-JUTSU, the hand jutsu. 術 is じゅつ as in 技術 (technology).

examples.ja: 父は来週、胃の手術を受ける。
examples.en: My father is having stomach surgery next week.

items.note: 手術を受ける = have an operation. 術 is じゅつ, as in 技術.

mnemonic.meaning: 瞬 blink + 間 interval: the space of one blink. A moment.
mnemonic.reading: しゅん like 一瞬 (an instant), かん as in 時間 (time): the time of a blink.

examples.ja: ドアを開けた瞬間、猫が飛び出した。
examples.en: The moment I opened the door, the cat jumped out.

items.note: 〜た瞬間 = the instant something happened. 一瞬 (いっしゅん) = an instant.

mnemonic.meaning: 順 order + 調 tune: everything in order and in tune. Things are going smoothly.
mnemonic.reading: じゅん as in 順番 (turn, order), ちょう as in 調子 (condition): your condition is in order.

examples.ja: 新しい仕事は順調に進んでいる。
examples.en: The new job is going smoothly.

items.note: 順調に = smoothly, without trouble.

mnemonic.meaning: 休 rest + 憩 relax: rest and relax. A break.
mnemonic.reading: On your break you stand in a QUEUE for CAKE (きゅう・けい).

examples.ja: 二時間働いたら、十分休憩しよう。
examples.en: After two hours of work, let's take a ten-minute break.

items.note: 休憩する = take a short break. 休暇 (きゅうか) = time off, a vacation.

mnemonic.meaning: 偶 chance + 然 just so: it just so happened, by chance.
mnemonic.reading: While meditating in ZEN, you step in GOO (ぐう・ぜん). Pure coincidence.

examples.ja: 駅で偶然昔の友達に会った。
examples.en: I ran into an old friend at the station by chance.

items.note: 偶然 = by chance. The opposite is わざと (on purpose).

mnemonic.meaning: 帰 return home + 宅 house: returning to your house.
mnemonic.reading: You get home and hang your KEY on a TACK (き・たく). き as in 帰国 (returning to your country).

examples.ja: 毎日、夜八時ごろ帰宅する。
examples.en: I get home around 8 p.m. every day.

items.note: 帰宅 = coming home (a bit formal). 帰国 (きこく) = returning to your country.

mnemonic.meaning: 無 nothing + 駄 worthless: nothing but worthless. A waste.
mnemonic.reading: A cow watches you and says "MOO... DUH (む・だ). That's pointless."

examples.ja: 使わない物を買うのは、お金の無駄だ。
examples.en: Buying things you won't use is a waste of money.

items.note: 無駄 = waste. 無駄にする = to waste something. 無 is む here.

mnemonic.meaning: 化 transform + 粧 adorn: transform your face with adornment. Makeup.
mnemonic.reading: Makeup is how KAY gets ready for the SHOW (け・しょう).

examples.ja: 姉は出かける前に、三十分も化粧する。
examples.en: My sister spends thirty minutes on makeup before going out.

items.note: 化 is け here (usually か, as in 化学).

mnemonic.meaning: 交 exchange + 換 replace: swap one thing for another.
mnemonic.reading: You trade a COKE for a CAN (こう・かん). こう as in 交通 (traffic).

examples.ja: サイズが合わなかったので、店で交換してもらった。
examples.en: The size didn't fit, so I had it exchanged at the store.

items.note: 交換 = swap one thing for another. 返品 (へんぴん) = returning something for a refund.

mnemonic.meaning: 飽 has 食 (eat): you've eaten your fill. You're sick of it.
mnemonic.reading: "AH, KILL me (あきる), not this show again." You're tired of it.

examples.ja: 同じゲームばかりしていると、すぐ飽きる。
examples.en: If you only play the same game, you soon get bored of it.

items.note: 〜に飽きる = get tired of something. 呆れる (あきれる) = be appalled.

mnemonic.meaning: 叫 has 口 (mouth): open your mouth wide and shout.
mnemonic.reading: After too much SAKE, you shout "BOO!" at everyone (さけ・ぶ). Don't mix it up with 避ける.

examples.ja: 火事に気づいた人が「火事だ！」と叫んだ。
examples.en: Someone who noticed the fire shouted, "Fire!"

items.note: 叫ぶ = shout or scream. 呼ぶ (よぶ) = call someone.

mnemonic.meaning: 黙 is 黒 (black) + 犬 (dog): the black dog goes silent.
mnemonic.reading: Your words hit a DAM (だま・る) and stop. You go quiet.

examples.ja: 怒られると、弟はいつも黙る。
examples.en: Whenever he gets scolded, my little brother goes quiet.

items.note: 黙る = stop talking. 黙って = without saying anything.

mnemonic.meaning: 揚 raise: food rises and bubbles up in hot oil. Deep-fry, like 唐揚げ (fried chicken).
mnemonic.reading: Same sound as 上げる (raise): fried food rises in the oil. From 唐揚げ (からあげ).

examples.ja: 鶏肉を油で揚げる。
examples.en: I deep-fry the chicken in oil.

items.note: 揚げる = deep-fry (唐揚げ, 天ぷら). Same reading as 上げる (raise).

mnemonic.meaning: 実 reality + は: "as for the reality..." Actually.
mnemonic.reading: じつ as in 事実 (fact). は is written は but read わ, like the topic particle.

examples.ja: 実は、明日の約束を忘れていた。
examples.en: Actually, I'd forgotten about tomorrow's plans.

items.note: 実は = actually, used to admit or reveal something. The は is read わ.

mnemonic.meaning: 自 self + 身 body: your own body. Oneself.
mnemonic.reading: Same sound as 地震 (earthquake) and 自信 (confidence): I myself (自身) kept my confidence (自信) through the earthquake (地震).

examples.ja: これは私自身の問題だから、自分で決める。
examples.en: This is my own problem, so I'll decide for myself.

items.note: 自身 = oneself (私自身 = I myself). 自信 (confidence) and 地震 (earthquake) are also じしん.

mnemonic.meaning: 本 true + 人 person: the true person. The person themselves.
mnemonic.reading: ほん as in 日本, にん as in 三人 (three people). Both regular readings.

examples.ja: 手続きには本人が来てください。
examples.en: The person themselves must come in for the procedure.

items.note: 本人 = the person in question, not an agent or a relative.

mnemonic.meaning: 覚 realize + 悟 enlightenment: you realize what's coming and accept it. Resolve.
mnemonic.reading: You steel yourself and shout "KAKU... GO!" (かく・ご)

examples.ja: 失敗する覚悟で、挑戦してみた。
examples.en: I gave it a try, prepared to fail.

items.note: 覚悟する = brace yourself for something hard. 覚 is かく here, not おぼ.

mnemonic.meaning: 人 person + 物 thing: a person you describe like a thing. A character.
mnemonic.reading: じん as in 日本人, ぶつ as in 動物 (animal). Here it's じん, not にん.

examples.ja: この小説の中で、一番好きな人物は誰？
examples.en: Who is your favorite character in this novel?

items.note: 人物 = a person, especially a notable one or a character. 物 is ぶつ here, like 動物.

mnemonic.meaning: Monks CHANT properly, every word exactly the way it should be.

examples.ja: 朝ご飯はちゃんと食べたほうがいい。
examples.en: You should eat a proper breakfast.

items.note: ちゃんと = properly, as it should be done. ちゃんとした = decent, proper.

mnemonic.meaning: A CANARY (かなり) that sings quite loudly. Considerably loud.

examples.ja: 今日はかなり寒い。
examples.en: It's quite cold today.

items.note: かなり = quite, more than you might expect. 相当 is similar but a bit stronger.

mnemonic.meaning: TONY is rambling, so you cut him off (とにかく): "Anyway, let's go!"

examples.ja: 理由はあとで話すから、とにかく来てください。
examples.en: I'll explain why later, so just come anyway.

items.note: とにかく = anyway: set the details aside and do the main thing first.

mnemonic.meaning: 印 stamp + 象 image: the image stamped on your mind. An impression.
mnemonic.reading: Your first impression happens IN the SHOW (いん・しょう). しょう as in 現象 (phenomenon).

examples.ja: 彼女の第一印象はとてもよかった。
examples.en: My first impression of her was very good.

items.note: 象 is しょう here, with a long vowel. 第一印象 = first impression.

mnemonic.meaning: 記 record + 憶 recollect: something recorded that you recollect. A memory.
mnemonic.reading: You carve a memory into an OAK tree with your KEY (き・おく). き as in 日記 (diary).

examples.ja: 子どものころの記憶は、あまりない。
examples.en: I don't have many memories from my childhood.

items.note: 記憶 = what you remember. 記録 (きろく) = a written record.

mnemonic.meaning: 慌 has 忄 (heart): your heart races. You panic.
mnemonic.reading: "AWW, TERRible, I'm late!" (あわてる) you panic.

examples.ja: 地震が起きても、慌てる必要はない。
examples.en: Even if an earthquake happens, there's no need to panic.

items.note: 慌てて = in a hurry, flustered. The opposite is 落ち着く (to calm down).

mnemonic.meaning: 興 excitement + 奮 stir up: stirred-up excitement.
mnemonic.reading: A KO is FUN (こう・ふん): the crowd gets worked up.

examples.ja: 試合に勝って、みんな興奮していた。
examples.en: We won the game and everyone was excited.

items.note: 興奮する = get excited or worked up.

mnemonic.meaning: 後 after + 悔 regret: the regret that comes after.
mnemonic.reading: こう as in 後半 (second half): regret comes in the second half. Same sound as 航海 (voyage).

examples.ja: 若いころもっと勉強すればよかったと後悔している。
examples.en: I regret not studying more when I was young.

items.note: 後悔する = regret. 航海 (also こうかい) = a sea voyage.

mnemonic.meaning: 滞 stay + 在 exist: staying and being present somewhere. A stay.
mnemonic.reading: You TIE (たい) yourself to one place for your stay. 滞 is たい as in 渋滞; ざい as in 現在 (present).

examples.ja: 日本には二週間滞在する予定だ。
examples.en: I plan to stay in Japan for two weeks.

items.note: 滞在 = staying somewhere for a while, e.g. on a trip or at a hotel.
